tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Compactness of the minimizing polygon space] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0326, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0327 ↗ appb-def-proper-geodesic-k-gon ↗ appb-def-geodesic-k-gon 1. Lemma B.68\group comparison-theorems

The space $\Lambda $ of nondegenerate geodesic $2$-gons in a fixed compact Busemann sublevel set with bounded total length is closed in the ambient compact parameter space $\Xi $, hence compact.
